Bug_Title: MS: Field should be moved out of an interface and made package protected (MS_OOI_PKGPROTECT)
Bug_Details:
A final static field that is
defined in an interface references a mutable
   object such as an array or hashtable.
   This mutable object could
   be changed by malicious code or
        by accident from another package.
   To solve this, the field needs to be moved to a class
   and made package protected
   to avoid
        this vulnerability.
Bug_Explanation: A final static field that is defined in a class references a mutable object such as a HashSet. This mutable object could be changed by malicious code or by accident from another class. To solve this, the field needs to be made package protected (i.e., it should not be publicly accessible) to avoid this vulnerability.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the test case modifies the mutable set returned by the showBug method of the BuggyClass instance. This violates the rule 'MS: Field should be moved out of an interface and made package protected (MS_OOI_PKGPROTECT)' as the mutable set is accessible and modifiable from any class.
